```{r}
source(here::here("Simulations","MCMC","simulate.R"))
```

```{r, fig.height=12,fig.width=8}

p1 = df %>% ggplot(aes(x = X*D, y = a_gauss))+geom_point()
```

```{r, fig.height=12,fig.width=8}
fit = function(nn){
  
  qq = rnorm(1,1,1)
  
  df = simulate_data_smallest_space(n = nn)
  
  mod = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Simulations","MCMC","stanmodels","MCMC_sim.stan"))

  datastan = list(a = df$a_gauss,
                D = df$D,
                C = df$C,
                N = nrow(df),
                X = df$X)


  fit = mod$sample(data = datastan,
                   iter_warmup = 500,
                   refresh = 0,
                   iter_sampling = 500,
             parallel_chains = 4)
  
  div = data.frame(fit$diagnostic_summary())%>% mutate(sim = qq, trial = nn,
                                                      time = fit$time()$total)
  
    
  esti_real = fit$summary(c("lp__","sigma_choice","sigma_m","sigma_e","mean_choice","prec_conf","c0","c1")) %>% 
    mutate(simulated = c(NA,unique(df$sigma_k),unique(df$sigma_m),unique(df$sigma_e),
                         unique(df$mean_choice),unique(df$conf_prec),unique(df$c0),unique(df$c1))) %>% 
    mutate(div = max(div$num_divergent))

  
  data = df %>% mutate(conf_bin = cut(C,4),
                      stimulus  = as.factor(D),
                      participant = 1,
                      rating = as.numeric(as.factor(conf_bin)),
                      correct = ACC) %>% drop_na()


  
  mratio = fitMetaDprime(data)
  
    
  result = list(esti_real%>% mutate(sim = qq, trial = nn),
                df%>% mutate(sim = qq, trial = nn),
                div = div,
                mratio = mratio %>% mutate(sim = qq, trial = nn))
  
  return(result)
}

# qq = fit(nn = 200)


library(furrr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyverse)

plan(multisession, workers = 10)  # Windows-friendly

safe_function <- possibly(fit, otherwise = "Error")

# Run 20 times in parallel
results_list <- future_map(1:2000, ~ safe_function(1000), .progress = T)

saveRDS(results_list,here::here("Simulations","MCMC","Saved models","2000sim_1000trials_smallest_space_MCMC.RData"))

results_list = results_list[-which(results_list == "Error")]
```

```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
map_dfr(results_list,1) %>% 
  mutate(div = as.factor(ifelse(div > 0,1,0))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = simulated, y = mean, ymin = q5, ymax = q95, col = div))+geom_pointrange()+
  geom_abline()+facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free")

```

```{r}
map_dfr(results_list,1) %>% 
  mutate(div = as.factor(ifelse(div > 0,1,0))) %>% select(div,sim) %>% distinct() %>% group_by(div) %>% summarise(n())

d1 = map_dfr(results_list,1) %>% 
  mutate(div = (ifelse(div > 0,div,NA))) %>%
  drop_na() %>% 
  filter(variable %in% c("sigma_choice","sigma_m","sigma_e","mean_choice","prec_conf")) %>% 
  select(mean,simulated, div, variable,sim) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "variable",values_from = c("mean","simulated"))

lin = lm(log(div) ~ mean_sigma_choice*mean_sigma_m*mean_sigma_e, data = d1)

grid <- expand.grid(
  mean_sigma_choice = seq(
    min(d1$mean_sigma_choice),
    max(d1$mean_sigma_choice),
    length.out = 50
  ),
  mean_sigma_m = seq(
    min(d1$mean_sigma_m),
    max(d1$mean_sigma_m),
    length.out = 50
  ),
  mean_sigma_e = seq(
    min(d1$mean_sigma_e),
    max(d1$mean_sigma_e),
    length.out = 50
  )
)

grid$div_hat_lm <- predict(
  lin,
  newdata = grid
)

library(ggplot2)
library(gganimate)

p_lm <- ggplot(
  grid,
  aes(
    x = mean_sigma_choice,
    y = mean_sigma_e,
    fill = div_hat_lm
  )
) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(sigma[k]),
    y = expression(sigma[e])
  ) +
  ggtitle("sigma_m = {round(frame_time, 2)}") +
  theme_minimal() +
  transition_time(mean_sigma_m) +
  ease_aes("linear")

anim_lm <- animate(
  p_lm,
  nframes = length(unique(grid$mean_sigma_m)),
  fps = 5,
  width = 500,
  height = 500,
  renderer = gifski_renderer()
)

anim_lm


```

```{r}
d2 = map_dfr(results_list,1) %>% 
  mutate(div = as.factor(ifelse(div > 0,1,0))) %>%
  filter(variable %in% c("sigma_choice","sigma_m","sigma_e","mean_choice","prec_conf")) %>% 
  select(mean,simulated, div, variable,sim) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "variable",values_from = c("mean","simulated"))

logs = glm(div ~ mean_sigma_choice*mean_sigma_m*mean_sigma_e, family = "binomial", data = d2)

grid <- expand.grid(
  mean_sigma_choice = seq(
    min(d2$mean_sigma_choice),
    max(d2$mean_sigma_choice),
    length.out = 50
  ),
  mean_sigma_m = seq(
    min(d2$mean_sigma_m),
    max(d2$mean_sigma_m),
    length.out = 50
  ),
  mean_sigma_e = seq(
    min(d2$mean_sigma_e),
    max(d2$mean_sigma_e),
    length.out = 50
  )
)

grid$div_prob <- predict(
  logs,
  newdata = grid,
  type = "response"   # gives P(divergence)
)


library(ggplot2)
library(gganimate)
p <- ggplot(
  grid,
  aes(
    x = mean_sigma_choice,
    y = mean_sigma_e,
    fill = div_prob
  )
) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    name = "P(divergence)"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(sigma_k),
    y = expression(sigma_e)
  ) +
  ggtitle("sigma_m = {round(frame_time,0)}")+
  theme_minimal() +
  transition_time(mean_sigma_m) +
  ease_aes("linear")

anim <- animate(
  p,
  nframes = length(unique(grid$mean_sigma_e)),
  fps = 5,
  width = 500,
  height = 500,
  renderer = gifski_renderer()
)

anim


```
